title_zh: 按销售曲线修正下降幅度的表述

scenario.label_zh: 按销售曲线修正下降幅度的表述
scenario.goal_zh: 区分峰值后的小幅回落与暴跌，并约定不凭一周数据预测后续走势

context_zh: 同事练习解读一份虚构商店月度销售图，不涉及真实投资建议。
author: author-phase11-c

sentences.speaker: Milo
sentences.text: Sales reached a peak of two hundred units in week three, then fell to a hundred and eighty.

sentences.speaker: June
sentences.text: The draft says sales plunge after week three. Isn’t that a fairly moderate fall compared with the earlier rise?

sentences.speaker: Milo
sentences.text: Yes. The line looks dramatic because the vertical scale starts at a hundred and seventy.

sentences.speaker: June
sentences.text: And what supports the gloomy outlook in the final sentence?

sentences.speaker: Milo
sentences.text: Nothing beyond that one week. I’ll describe the fall without predicting what happens next.

sentences.speaker: June
sentences.text: Good. Keep the actual numbers so readers can judge the size of the change.
